title: Fridge Temperature Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Fridge compartment temperature sensor open or short.
fullDescription:
E1 on a Grundig refrigerator indicates the NTC temperature sensor in the fridge compartment is reporting an out-of-range value. The fridge may run constantly or cycle erratically.

The sensor is usually clipped to the evaporator coil at the rear of the compartment. Replacements are inexpensive and can be swapped in under an hour.

fixSteps.title: Locate sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rear panel of fridge compartment.

faq.a: Check contents if compartment was warm for hours.

title: Freezer Temperature Sensor Fault
fullDescription: E2 indicates the freezer compartment temperature sensor is reading out of range. Freezer may be too warm or too cold.

title: Evaporator Sensor Fault
fullDescription: E3 indicates the defrost/evaporator NTC is reporting invalid values, preventing correct defrost timing. Frost builds up and cooling degrades.

faq.a: Defrost cycle relies on this sensor.

title: Defrost Heater Fault
shortDescription: Defrost heater open circuit or thermostat failed.
fullDescription: E4 indicates the defrost system (heater element + bi-metal thermostat) has failed. Evaporator ices up heavily and cooling is lost.

title: Evaporator Fan Fault
shortDescription: Circulation fan not running or reporting invalid speed.
fullDescription: E5 indicates the freezer evaporator fan is obstructed, iced up, or electrically failed. Cooling distribution to the fridge section stops.

faq.a: Yes, a defrost fault can ice the fan.

title: Compressor Fault
shortDescription: Compressor not starting or drawing abnormal current.
fullDescription: E6 indicates the PCB detected a compressor start failure — open windings, failed relay, or seized mechanicals. Usually requires professional service.

fixSteps.title: Test relay
fixSteps.instruction: Check start relay/overload module on compressor.

faq.a: Relay swap yes, compressor swap no.

title: Door Left Open Alarm
shortDescription: Door has been open beyond the alarm threshold.
fullDescription: E7 is raised when the door switch reports open for more than 2-3 minutes. Also appears if the reed switch fails mechanically.

fixSteps.title: Close door
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure door closes fully and seal is clean.

title: Ice Maker Fault
fullDescription: E8 indicates the ice maker cannot complete a cycle — frozen water supply, failed mould heater, or jammed ejector motor.

fixSteps.title: Thaw inlet
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off ice maker, allow inlet tube to thaw.

faq.a: Check inlet valve and supply line.

title: Ambient Temperature Too High
fullDescription: E9 indicates the ambient sensor has measured a temperature above the climate class rating (usually 43°C). Move the fridge to a cooler space or improve ventilation.
whenToCallPro: If ambient is normal but E9 persists.

title: Control Board Fault
shortDescription: Main PCB communication or checksum fault.
fullDescription: E10 is raised on internal control board faults — corrupted EEPROM or communication failure between boards. Power cycle may clear transients; otherwise PCB replacement.
